problem_statement: Return True if s is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards), case-insensitively. The entire string is lowercased using str.lower() before comparison. s is any Python string, including an empty string.
valid_input_domain: Return True if s is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards), case-insensitively. The entire string is lowercased using str.lower() before comparison. s is any Python string, including an empty string.
bug_explanation: The faulty solution omits the lower() call, so characters differing only in case are treated as different.
